la:noun:pampinus.gloss: foliage of a vine, vine-shoot, vine leaf
senses: foliage of a vine, vine-shoot, vine leaf
la:noun:pampinus.html:
pampĭnus, i, m. and f. (in
fem.: circumflua pampinus,: opaca, id. Epith. Pall. et Celer. 5; cf. P.; , acc. to whom Varro often used the word as a fem.) [root pamp-, pap-, to swell, v. pōpulus; cf. papula, pustule], a tendril or young shoot of a vine (cf. palmes).
Lit., : ex gemmis pampini pullulant,: pampinos detergere,: detrahere,.—
A vine-leaf, the foliage of a vine: involvulus, quae in pampini folio intorta implicat se,: uva vestita pampinis,: male defendet pampinus uvas,: ornatus viridi tempora pampino Liber,: pampini densitas,.—
Transf., a clasper or tendril of any climbing plant, ; .
